choose.when: AND ( n.writer_id = #{ctx.userId} OR n.target_type = 'ALL' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM notice_targets t WHERE t.notice_id = n.notice_id AND t.target_type = 'TEACHER' AND t.target_ref_id = COALESCE(#{ctx.teacherId}::bigint, -1)) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM notice_targets t JOIN classes c ON c.class_id = t.target_ref_id AND c.teacher_id = COALESCE(#{ctx.teacherId}::bigint, -1) WHERE t.notice_id = n.notice_id AND t.target_type = 'CLASS') )

AND ( n.target_type = 'ALL' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM notice_targets t WHERE t.notice_id = n.notice_id AND t.target_type = 'STUDENT' AND t.target_ref_id = COALESCE(#{ctx.studentId}::bigint, -1)) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM notice_targets t JOIN enrollments e ON e.class_id = t.target_ref_id AND e.student_id = COALESCE(#{ctx.studentId}::bigint, -1) AND e.status_code = 'ACTIVE' WHERE t.notice_id = n.notice_id AND t.target_type = 'CLASS') )

AND ( n.target_type = 'ALL' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM notice_targets t WHERE t.notice_id = n.notice_id AND t.target_type = 'PARENT' AND t.target_ref_id = COALESCE(#{ctx.parentId}::bigint, -1)) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM notice_targets t JOIN student_parents sp ON sp.student_id = t.target_ref_id AND sp.parent_id = COALESCE(#{ctx.parentId}::bigint, -1) WHERE t.notice_id = n.notice_id AND t.target_type = 'STUDENT') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM notice_targets t JOIN enrollments e ON e.class_id = t.target_ref_id AND e.status_code = 'ACTIVE' JOIN student_parents sp ON sp.student_id = e.student_id AND sp.parent_id = COALESCE(#{ctx.parentId}::bigint, -1) WHERE t.notice_id = n.notice_id AND t.target_type = 'CLASS') )

when.test: ctx.roleCode == "ADMIN" and cond != null and cond.statusCode != null and cond.statusCode != ""

sql.if: AND (n.title ILIKE '%' || #{cond.keyword} || '%' OR n.content ILIKE '%' || #{cond.keyword} || '%' OR u.name ILIKE '%' || #{cond.keyword} || '%')

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notices (title, content, writer_id, target_type) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{writerId}, #{targetType})
mapper.select: SELECT n.notice_id, n.title, n.content, n.writer_id, n.target_type, n.notice_status, n.created_at, n.updated_at, u.name AS writer_name, u.login_id AS writer_login_id FROM notices n JOIN users u ON u.user_id = n.writer_id WHERE n.notice_id = #{noticeId}

SELECT n.notice_id, n.title, n.content, n.writer_id, n.target_type, n.notice_status, n.created_at, n.updated_at, u.name AS writer_name, u.login_id AS writer_login_id, COALESCE(r.read_yn, 'N') AS read_yn, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notice_reads nr WHERE nr.notice_id = n.notice_id AND nr.read_yn = 'Y') AS read_count FROM notices n JOIN users u ON u.user_id = n.writer_id LEFT JOIN notice_reads r ON r.notice_id = n.notice_id AND r.user_id = #{ctx.userId} WHERE n.notice_id = #{noticeId}

SELECT n.notice_id, n.title, n.writer_id, n.target_type, n.notice_status, n.created_at, n.updated_at, u.name AS writer_name, u.login_id AS writer_login_id, COALESCE(r.read_yn, 'N') AS read_yn, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notice_reads nr WHERE nr.notice_id = n.notice_id AND nr.read_yn = 'Y') AS read_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notice_files nf WHERE nf.notice_id = n.notice_id) AS file_count FROM notices n JOIN users u ON u.user_id = n.writer_id LEFT JOIN notice_reads r ON r.notice_id = n.notice_id AND r.user_id = #{ctx.userId} WHERE 1 = 1
ORDER BY n.notice_id DESC LIMIT #{cond.size} OFFSET #{cond.offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notices n JOIN users u ON u.user_id = n.writer_id WHERE 1 = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE notices SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, target_type = #{targetType}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE notice_id = #{noticeId}
UPDATE notices SET notice_status = #{noticeStatus}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE notice_id = #{noticeId}
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO notice_targets (notice_id, target_type, target_ref_id) VALUES
(#{noticeId}, #{targetType}, #{refId})
mapper.select: SELECT t.target_id, t.notice_id, t.target_type, t.target_ref_id, CASE t.target_type WHEN 'CLASS' THEN (SELECT c.class_name FROM classes c WHERE c.class_id = t.target_ref_id) WHEN 'STUDENT' THEN (SELECT u.name FROM students s JOIN users u ON u.user_id = s.user_id WHERE s.student_id = t.target_ref_id) WHEN 'PARENT' THEN (SELECT u.name FROM parents p JOIN users u ON u.user_id = p.user_id WHERE p.parent_id = t.target_ref_id) WHEN 'TEACHER' THEN (SELECT u.name FROM teachers te JOIN users u ON u.user_id = te.user_id WHERE te.teacher_id = t.target_ref_id) END AS target_name FROM notice_targets t WHERE t.notice_id = #{noticeId} ORDER BY t.target_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notice_reads (notice_id, user_id, read_yn, read_at) VALUES (#{noticeId}, #{userId}, 'Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON CONFLICT (notice_id, user_id) DO UPDATE SET read_yn = 'Y', read_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT student_id FROM students WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT parent_id FROM parents WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT teacher_id FROM teachers WHERE user_id = #{userId}
